facts.fact: Kale 知道这家修车铺专做什么。
facts.anchor: I know what this mechanic specializes in.

facts.fact: 他上次见表亲是在婚礼上，他是伴郎。
facts.anchor: The last time I saw him was at his wedding. I was the best man.

facts.fact: 他把那栋房子形容为女人进去就不出来的地方。
facts.anchor: One that women would go into but never leave.

facts.fact: 除毒品外他们还做皮肉生意。
facts.anchor: they also dealt in the flesh

facts.fact: Barley 与 Roux 坚决反对这门生意。
facts.anchor: Those families were vehemently against it.

facts.fact: Rondelle 与 Chard 兴奋地进房。
facts.anchor: Rondelle and Chard enter the room chatting excitedly.

facts.fact: 他说今晚又有一批货到。
facts.anchor: “They’ll be here tonight. Another shipment, I can’t wait to teach them manners.”

facts.fact: 他推翻「她是杀手」的判断，句子未完。
facts.anchor: I shouldn’t worry about a killer, but she isn’t—

facts.fact: 他怀疑警局有内鬼，想到 Cacao。
facts.anchor: Sergeant Cacao’s face flashes in my mind.

facts.fact: 他从车辆登记得知她真名。
那颗炸弹被设在十二小时后。
facts.anchor: She has it set to twelve hours on simmer.

facts.fact: 他本可以拔掉插头带走。
facts.anchor: I could unplug the crockpot, take it with me.
